world.b: The Houthis are threatening Saudi ports over the coalition's Hodeidah evacuation order. Follow Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran says another tanker on fire after hitting mine in Hormuz

world.b: Israel's caretaker prime minister called for an immediate end to his trial after judges cast doubt on the charges and recommended dropping the bribery case.
world.title: Netanyahu says corruption trial ‘must end’ as court suggests dropping case

world.h: Fuel truck fire kills at least 30 on Cairo ring road
world.b: A vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire above a tunnel in Giza's Warraq district, Egypt's health ministry said; 15 were injured.
world.title: At least 30 killed in Egypt vehicle fire, health ministry says

world.h: Iraq's top court lets Baghdad take over Kurdish borders
world.b: The ruling lets federal troops deploy to borders in the Kurdish region, a day after the prime minister ordered forces to take over Kurdish-run crossings and oil fields.

world.h: Solomon Islands bars foreign bases in Australia treaty
world.b: Solomon Islands signed a sweeping treaty with Australia affirming it will allow no foreign military bases, seen as a blow to China's regional ambitions.

national.h: Ábrego García leaves for Spain, hopes to return
national.b: The Salvadoran man mistakenly deported in 2025 arrived in Madrid on what his lawyer called a temporary departure, hoping to rejoin his family in Maryland.
national.title: Ábrego García, a Salvadoran mistakenly deported by U.S., goes to Spain but hopes to return after Trump

national.h: FDA to expand testing of prescription drugs
national.b: The FDA will test more drugs for impurities and quality lapses after a ProPublica investigation found it rarely tested generics doctors had flagged.
national.title: FDA to Expand Prescription Drug Testing After ProPublica Revealed Safety Concerns

national.h: Army calls Iowa lead azide detonation a success
national.b: Army officials said Wednesday's controlled detonation of 68 drums of volatile lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant 'wildly exceeded' expectations.
national.title: US Army declares Iowa lead azide detonation ‘tremendously successful’

national.h: Kilmar Abrego Garcia self-deports to Spain
national.b: Abrego Garcia, wrongfully deported to El Salvador last year, left voluntarily after months fighting a second deportation to Africa.

national.h: Alaska ends voter records deal with DOJ
national.b: Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom withdrew Alaska from a 2025 agreement giving the Justice Department access to state voter rolls.

politics.h: Young Republicans reckon with midterm losses
politics.b: In Fort Worth, Tarrant County Young Republicans met at a brewery to sort through what went wrong after midterms that devastated the party.
politics.title: These young Republicans have a message for their party: It's time to 'grow up'

politics.h: Judge orders Fulton County to give 2020 records to state board
politics.b: A Fulton County judge ordered a digital copy of ballots and records seized by the FBI delivered to Georgia's State Election Board, under a protective order.
politics.title: Georgia's Fulton County ordered to give copy of 2020 election records seized by FBI to state board

politics.h: Alaska ends voter data deal with Justice Department
politics.b: Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom ended the agreement to share the voter list, saying the department never flagged any potentially ineligible voters.
politics.title: Alaska ends voter data agreement with Justice Department, which had been searching for noncitizens

politics.h: Poll: Most voters want Iran war ended now
politics.b: A new poll finds a majority of US voters want the war on Iran to end immediately, even on less favorable terms.

international.h: Tinubu vows peace for Nigeria's northeast ahead of vote
international.b: At a rally in Maiduguri, President Bola Tinubu promised to restore peace to the rebellion-hit region as he seeks a second term on January 16.
international.title: Nigeria’s Tinubu pledges to bring peace to rebellion-hit border region

international.h: Ecuador and US review joint military operations
international.b: The US paused operations in Ecuador pending an investigation into one carried out by Ecuadoran forces that raised human rights questions.
international.title: Ecuador and US review joint military operations, official says

international.h: UK moves warplanes into hangars over drone threat
international.b: British outlets report the RAF is sheltering planes overnight and installing anti-drone nets; the Ministry of Defence says it takes base security very seriously.
international.title: UK military ‘moving aircraft to hangars in case of drone attacks’

international.h: Puigdemont to return to Spain on December 12
international.b: The Catalan separatist leader says he will end nearly a decade of exile after Spain's Supreme Court applied the amnesty law and shelved his case.

international.h: RSF drone attacks kill at least 19 in Sudan's Blue Nile
international.b: A rights group said Rapid Support Forces drones struck Damazin late Tuesday, killing at least 19 people and wounding at least 20.

international.h: Israeli strike kills Gaza security official and family
international.b: Gaza's Interior Ministry said an Israeli air attack killed Muhammad Majid Abu al-Awf, head of internal security in northern Gaza, with his wife and two daughters.

international.h: Two Libyan officers die after drone strike on Russian ship
international.b: Eastern Libyan forces said two naval officers died of wounds from Ukraine's drone attack on a Russian warship near Benghazi.
Saudi air defenses destroyed four drones over Ras Tanura, a day after a coalition air strike on Hodeidah; no casualties were initially reported.

international.h: Dozens feared trapped in flooded Indonesia mine
international.b: Rescuers are searching for workers trapped after an overflowing river flooded an unauthorized open-pit gold mine in West Java's Bogor district.

international.h: UK warns firms of Russian sabotage threat
international.b: The Defence Ministry and security officials warned companies supplying Ukraine's military that they could be targets of Russian sabotage.
After months of protests, the wage board agreed to lift the sector's minimum wage from 12,500 to 17,500 taka a month.
Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party agreed to a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's party in a bid to form Israel's next government.

international.h: WHO chief urges end to US fuel blockade on Cuba
international.b: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the sanctions endanger children's lives as fuel shortages strain Cuba's healthcare system.

business.h: Portland man's free newsletter tracks grocery prices
business.b: Bryan Vance has tracked 20 staples at more than a dozen stores since April 2025 in his Stumptown Savings newsletter, as food costs climb.

business.h: Trump administration plans new tariffs on China, EU and others
business.b: The proposal adds 20% to tariffs on Chinese goods and raises them on the EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and nine other trading partners.

business.h: Key inflation gauge rises to 3.8% in October
business.b: The Commerce Department said consumer prices rose 3.8% from a year earlier, up from 3.6% in September, even as gas price increases slowed.

business.h: Dollar Tree bets on wider range of products
business.b: After strong quarterly earnings, the discount retailer says adding items above a dollar lets it offer more brands, price points and pack sizes.

business.h: AI shopping agents can make costly mistakes
business.b: The NRF says 59% of shoppers plan to use AI this holiday weekend, but AI agents can hallucinate and work best when handed more personal data.
business.title: What to know before using AI agents for Black Friday shopping

business.h: Thieves turn to cyber tricks for cargo theft
business.b: Planet Money looks at how sophisticated criminals are stealing truckloads of food and goods, from bourbon to turkey, and why the FBI struggles to catch them.
business.title: How to steal a truckload of bourbon and not get caught : Planet Money

business.title: In a time of rising costs, one Thanksgiving commodity is cheaper: cannabis

business.h: Asian markets dive on AI doubts
business.b: Asian stocks fell sharply, reversing a rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.

science.h: Rare nearby supernova draws telescopes worldwide
science.b: Astronomers caught type Ia supernova SN 2026ahvu before it peaked, giving an early look at how these stellar explosions work.
science.title: A cosmically close supernova may spill the stellar explosion’s secrets

science.h: Australia's legless geckos evolved like snakes
science.b: Researchers found the 50 species of pygopod geckos, from Australia and New Guinea, show diet and body diversity patterns that resemble snakes'.
science.title: Australia's legless geckos evolved like snakes did

science.h: FCC approves SpaceX plan for 1 million orbiting data centers
science.b: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy 1,000,000 orbital compute modules, called Starmind, to meet growing demand for AI computing.
science.title: US grants SpaceX approval for 1 million space data centres

science.h: Ancient grasshoppers may have walked on water
science.b: Leg hairs preserved in 99-million-year-old amber suggest a newfound family of grasshoppers could skate on surface tension like water striders.
science.title: Extinct, long-legged grasshoppers walked on water alongside dinosaurs

sports.h: Senegal gets Africa Cup title back
sports.b: The Court of Arbitration for Sport overturned a ruling that had handed the Africa Cup of Nations trophy to Morocco after Senegal's players walked off.

goodnews.h: Little Free Bakeries bring neighbors together
goodnews.b: Like Little Free Libraries but with baked goods, pop-ups such as Sarah Mason's monthly table in Austin's North Loop draw lines of neighbors.
goodnews.title: At this Little Free Bakery in Austin, neighbors come for the pastries and stay for community connection

goodnews.b: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali docked at China's Tiangong space station, becoming the first foreign astronaut to board it, as Pakistan celebrated.

local.h: Board backs replacing Tompkins Square pull-up bars
local.b: The East Village community board supported the parks department's plan to replace the '90s-era calisthenics equipment in a nearly $10 million renovation.
local.title: Community board votes to replace iconic Tompkins Square Park pull-up bars

local.h: Monitor finds routine strip searches at Rikers
local.b: The federal monitor says detainees in restrictive housing were strip-searched leaving and returning to cells, against the department's own policy.
local.title: Rikers detainees were routinely strip-searched in violation of policy, monitor finds

local.h: Macy's Thanksgiving parade postponed to Saturday
local.b: City officials moved the 100th parade as a powerful storm with dangerous wind gusts heads for New York.
local.title: NYC postpones Thanksgiving parade to Saturday as wind gusts threaten disaster

local.h: Activists sue to stop Greenpoint waterfront towers
local.b: Friends of Bushwick Inlet Park say the 1,300-unit Monitor Point project sits in a floodplain and relies on outdated climate projections.
local.title: Brooklyn environmentalists sue to block Greenpoint waterfront development

local.h: Driver charged in killing of Brooklyn nurse
local.b: Police say Justin Mercado ran a red light at 55 mph on Third Avenue in August, killing 28-year-old nurse Jiayi Zheng in a crosswalk.
local.title: Driver charged with killing Brooklyn nurse crossing Third Avenue

local.b: A Manhattan judge rejected landlords' bid to block the two-year rent freeze for about 1 million stabilized apartments, a win for Mayor Mamdani.
local.title: Judge upholds NYC rent freeze, marking win for Mamdani and his affordability agenda

local.h: NYPD seeks six after group exits Manhattan manhole
local.b: Police say five people climbed out of a sewer at 2nd Avenue and East 17th Street on Nov. 18 and left in a red sedan driven by a sixth.
local.title: NYPD searches for 6 sewer spelunkers seen exiting a Manhattan manhole

local.h: Queens DA Katz sues to block wrongful-conviction probe
local.b: Katz argues the state's new prosecutorial conduct commission is unconstitutional as it seeks records on three men wrongly convicted under former DA Richard Brown.
local.title: Queens DA Katz seeks to block prosecutor watchdog investigating wrongful convictions
